paite: Huan TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
heading: Khawnvakte Koihna
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

paite: "Aaron houpih inla, akiang ah, khawnvak na det chiang in khawnvak sagihte'n sathau khawnvak koihna malam atatvak ding uh ahi," chi in.
english: “Speak to Aaron, and tell him, ‘When you light the lamps, the seven lamps shall give light in front of the lampstand.’”

paite: Aaron in huchibang in ahih a; TOUPA'N Mosi thu apiak bang in khawnvak koihna malam ah khawnvakte ade hi.
english: Aaron did so. He lit its lamps to light the area in front of the lampstand, as Yahweh commanded Moses.

paite: Hiai khawnvak koihna ahihleh dangka-eng a sekthoh chi ahi a; amung bul a kipan apak tan a sekthoh ahi. Alim TOUPA'N Mosi a-etsak bang geih a khawnvak koihna bawl ahi.
english: This was the workmanship of the lampstand, beaten work of gold. From its base to its flowers, it was beaten work: according to the pattern which Yahweh had shown Moses, so he made the lampstand.

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
heading: Levite Siansakna Leh Latna
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

paite: "Levite, Israel suante lak a pan hihtuam inla, hihsiangthou in.
english: “Take the Levites from among the children of Israel, and cleanse them.

paite: Amaute hihsiangthou ding in hichibang in na hih ding ahi. Atung uah sawpsianna tui sung inla, apumpi tengteng uh metsak inla, apuante uh sawpsak inla, kihihsiangthousak in.
english: You shall do this to them, to cleanse them: sprinkle the water of cleansing on them, let them shave their whole bodies with a razor, and let them wash their clothes, and cleanse themselves.

paite: Bawngtaltuai khat tangbuang thillat thau toh hel tangbuang nel mahmah toh lasak inla, khelh thoihna ding in bawngtaltuai khat dang leng na kaisak ding ahi.
english: Then let them take a young bull, and its meal offering, fine flour mixed with oil; and another young bull you shall take for a sin offering.

paite: Levite kihoupihna biakbuk bul ah pi inla, Israel suan omkhawm tengteng kigawmkhawmsak vek in.
english: You shall present the Levites before the Tent of Meeting. You shall assemble the whole congregation of the children of Israel.

paite: Levite TOUPA kiang ah na lan dia; Israel suante'n Levite tung ah akhut uh anga ding uhi.
english: You shall present the Levites before Yahweh. The children of Israel shall lay their hands on the Levites,

paite: Huchi in Aaron in Levite, TOUPA nna aseptheihna ding un Israel suante min in vei thillat TOUPA kiang ah alan ding.
english: and Aaron shall offer the Levites before Yahweh for a wave offering, on the behalf of the children of Israel, that it may be theirs to do the service of Yahweh.

paite: Levite'n bawngtalte lutung ah akhut uh anga ding ua; Levite a dia kilemna bawlna ding in, khat, khelh thoihna ding in, akhat pen halmang thillat ding in TOUPA kiang ah alan ding ahi.
english: “The Levites shall lay their hands on the heads of the bulls, and you shall offer the one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering to Yahweh, to make atonement for the Levites.

paite: "Levite Aaron leh atapate ma ah na omsak dia, TOUPA a ding in vei thillat ding in na lan ding ahi.
english: You shall set the Levites before Aaron, and before his sons, and offer them as a wave offering to Yahweh.

paite: Huchibang in Israel suante lak a pan Levite na hihtuam dia, huchi in Levite kei a ahi ding uh.
english: Thus you shall separate the Levites from among the children of Israel, and the Levites shall be mine.

paite: Huai khit in Levite kihoupihna biakbuk nasem ding in alut ding ua, nang amaute na hihsiangthou ding, vei thillat ding in na lan ding ahi.
english: “After that, the Levites shall go in to do the service of the Tent of Meeting: and you shall cleanse them, and offer them as a wave offering.

paite: Israel suante lak a pan kei a tuam dia seh ahi ngal ua. Sul hong tengteng, Israel suante ta masapen teng tang in kei a ding in ka neita hi.
english: For they are wholly given to me from among the children of Israel; instead of all who open the womb, even the firstborn of all the children of Israel, I have taken them to me.

paite: Israel suante lak a ta masapente, mihing toh ganta toh kei a ahi him uhi. Aigupta gam a ta masapente ka sihsak lai in kei a tuam dia ka sehsa ahi.
english: For all the firstborn among the children of Israel are mine, both man and animal. On the day that I struck all the firstborn in the land of Egypt, I sanctified them for myself.

paite: Huchi in Israel suante lak a ta masapente tang in Levite ka nei khinta ahi.
english: I have taken the Levites instead of all the firstborn among the children of Israel.

paite: Huchi in Israel suante tang a kihoupihna biakbuk a nasem ding leh Israel suante'n mun siangthou ahon naih ua leng Israel suante lak a hii alenlouhna dia lemna bawl ding in Israel suante lak a pan Levite Aaron leh atapate ka pia ahi," achi hi.
english: I have given the Levites as a gift to Aaron and to his sons from among the children of Israel, to do the service of the children of Israel in the Tent of Meeting, and to make atonement for the children of Israel; that there be no plague among the children of Israel, when the children of Israel come near to the sanctuary.”

paite: Huchibang in Mosi, Aaron leh Israel suan omkhawm tengteng in Levite tung ah ahihta uhi. Levite tungtang thu a TOUPA'N Mosi thu apiak tengteng bang in atung uah Israel suante'n ahih uhi.
english: Moses, and Aaron, and all the congregation of the children of Israel did so to the Levites. According to all that Yahweh commanded Moses concerning the Levites, so the children of Israel did to them.

paite: Huchi in Levite siansak ahi ua, apuante uh asawp ua; Aaron in TOUPA ma ah vei thillat ding in alan hi. Amau hihsianthouna ding in Aaron in kilemna abawlsak hi.
english: The Levites purified themselves from sin, and they washed their clothes; and Aaron offered them for a wave offering before Yahweh; and Aaron made atonement for them to cleanse them.

paite: Huai zoh in Levite Aaron leh atapate nuai a, anasep uh sem ding in kihoupihna biakbuk sung ah alut uhi. Levite tungtang thu a TOUPA'N Mosi thu apiak bang in atung uah ahihta hi.
english: After that, the Levites went in to do their service in the Tent of Meeting before Aaron, and before his sons: as Yahweh had commanded Moses concerning the Levites, so they did to them.

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

paite: "Levite tantuam hiaite ahi. Kum sawmnih-le-nga chiang tunglam in kihoupihna biakbuk a nasep asem ding uh.
english: “This is that which belongs to the Levites: from twenty-five years old and upward they shall go in to wait on the service in the work of the Tent of Meeting;

paite: Kum sawmnga a upate'n anasep uh akhawlsan ding ua, nna asem nawn kei ding uh.
english: and from the age of fifty years they shall cease waiting on the work, and shall serve no more,

paite: Himahleh khawmpite biakbuk kep thu ah a-unaute uh ahuh zel ding ua, nasep zaw asem nawn kei ding uh. Hichibang in Levite nasep na gelsak ding ahi," achi hi.
english: but shall minister with their brothers in the Tent of Meeting, to perform the duty, and shall do no service. You shall do thus to the Levites concerning their duties.”
